name: defense-tech-map
description: Interactive defense tech market map, built into a single self-contained HTML file.

scripts.budget:build: node scripts/export-taxonomy.mjs && python3 -m budget.etl build && node scripts/build-budget-dashboard.mjs
scripts.budget:sample: node scripts/export-taxonomy.mjs && python3 -m budget.etl sample && node scripts/build-budget-dashboard.mjs
scripts.budget:test: python3 -m pytest budget/tests -q && npm run budget:sample && node --test budget/tests/dashboard.spec.mjs
